hypothesis: Replacing the rank-deficient Barlow Twins redundancy reduction loss with an InfoNCE (SimCLR) contrastive loss will accelerate representation learning in a short 50-epoch budget.
rationale: Under a compute constraint of 50 epochs with batch size 512, Barlow Twins' cross-correlation matrix on 2048-dimensional projections is rank-deficient (rank <= 512) and noisy, leading to slow feature convergence (0.2867 linear probe accuracy). Contrastive InfoNCE directly optimizes sample discriminability over negative pairs in the batch, yielding much faster representation learning per epoch.
expected_effect: Significantly higher linear-probe top-1 accuracy on validation data compared to baseline (0.2867).
change_summary: Implemented InfoNCE contrastive loss with temperature 0.2 inside BarlowTwinsLoss, adjusted learning rate to 0.5 for SGD with batch size 512.
feedback: ACCEPTED: val_acc 0.5141 > best 0.2867 (+22.74 pts). Now the best.
